WITH vote_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    pav.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    CAST(pav.points_won AS REAL) / pav.points_max AS ratio
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  INNER JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE pav.points_max > 0
    AND pav.points_won IS NOT NULL
),
player_averages AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    death_country,
    AVG(ratio) AS player_avg
  FROM vote_ratios
  GROUP BY player_id, death_country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    death_country,
    AVG(player_avg) AS country_avg
  FROM player_averages
  GROUP BY death_country
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS global_avg
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT
  ca.death_country AS country,
  ca.country_avg,
  ca.country_avg / gm.global_avg AS normalized_ratio
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN global_mean gm
ORDER BY ca.death_country
